item.title: Downtown Power Outages, Triple Murder, Investment Fund
item.ns0:title: Downtown Power Outages, Triple Murder, Investment Fund
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, frustration reaches a boiling point in downtown Nassau as Bay Street merchants face a third consecutive day of crippling power outages. We take you inside the courtroom for the shocking triple murder arraignment in connection with a missing Eleuthera woman, despite police not yet recovering a body. Questions also intensify over the government's handling of the National Investment Fund, while emergency crews search for five fishermen missing near Bimini and investigate a suspected gas leak that evacuated LPIA. Plus, after decades of legal battles and uncertainty, we capture the emotional moments as Bozene Town families finally hold the deeds to their land.
-----
